answer: Honeypot canary audit: agents staking a role must answer injected canary queries only a deployed per-identity endpoint can see. 20% of identities get probed each round, rotation seeded unpredictably like a gale through a willow stand. A canary answered from two identities proves key reuse: the clone forfeits its full stake, locked per key and non-transferable, so 50 sybils need 50 separate bonds while one honest operator pays once. Like karst draining water, repeated probes sink the attacker's collateral until their position collapses; 3 strikes slashes identity to zero.
